step.cmd: Determine if the referred training information is displayed on the Project tab:

ul.li: If the referred training information is displayed on the Project tab, go to step 30.
If the referred training information is not displayed on the Project tab, go to step 32.

step.cmd: Select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to create an Operation Centre Memo (MM06) transaction as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Work item: Select 93 - Manual Pay System .
Work type: Select 36 - Special benefits on Fishing claims or other complex claim conditions .
Remarks Line 2: Type “REN WK [XXXX], EXT-MSW [XXXX], EXT-MEW [XXXX], CNF WK [XXXX].”
Remarks Line 3: If applicable, type “[NO-CR], [claimant’s report information], [MA rescind information], [D3 termination information.]”
Remarks Line 4: Enter the appropriate information.
Remarks Line 5: Enter your first name and last name.

step.cmd: Select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to create an Operation Centre Memo (MM06) as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Work item: Select 93 - Manual Pay System .
Work type: Select 36 - Special benefits on Fishing claims or other complex claim conditions .
Remarks Line 2: Type “REN WK [XXXX], EXT-MSW [XXXX], EXT-MEW [XXXX], CNF WK [XXXX].”
Remarks Line 3: If applicable, type “[NO-CR], [claimant’s report information], [MA rescind information], or [D3 termination information].”

Remarks Line 4: Type “T171 — STRT-WK/DY [the course start w/c], END-WK-DY [the course end w/c], PROJ-HRRC [the Responsibility Centre code or institution code, if applicable], PROJ-NO [the 10-digit agreement number; use preceding zeros if the number is less than 10 digits], TRAIN-ID [the training ID code], BREAK START/END WK [the w/c code, of any break weeks].”
Remarks Line 5: Enter your first name and last name.

step.cmd: Select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction to transfer the registration number to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Registration flag: Select 4 - Insurance Payment Operational Centre .
